module: Auxiliary sequential lever animation controller: at each gear change of the "gearbox" device (upshift = lever pushed, downshift = lever pulled), it makes a smoothed value oscillate between -1, 0 and 1 published in electrics.values.sequentialLeverY, and plays a lever sound (up / down) with the shift aggression as a parameter.
notes: jbeam keys read: electricsNameYAxis ("sequentialLeverY"), supportedGearboxTypes (list, {"sequentialGearbox"}), relevantGearboxName ("gearbox"), shiftSoundNode_nodes (first element = sound node, otherwise 0 + log W), shiftSoundEventSequentialGearUp ("event:>Vehicle>Interior>Gearshift>sequential_01_in"), shiftSoundEventSequentialGearDown ("..._01_out"), shiftSoundVolumeSequentialGearUp / Down (0.5).
If the device does not exist or is not of a supported type, logs E and updateGFX becomes nop.

Lever direction: impulse = {-1 -> 1, 0 -> 0, 1 -> -1} depending on the sign of (gearIndex - previousGearIndex); the "down" sound is played as soon as the impulse is non-zero (the name value "shiftOut" corresponds to any gear change, up or down), the "up" sound when it returns to 0.

init.desc: Gets the gearbox device, checks its type and reads the sounds.

reset.desc: Resets the lever state and the smoother to zero.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: detects the gear change, smooths the impulse, plays the sound and publishes the value.
